==About==

A {{i|Big Autumn}} is the product of a third growth stage, second tier {{i|Pumpkin}} Harvest. Right-clicking a Big Autumn and selecting "Slice" will give you 6x {{i|Pumpkin Flesh}} and 15x {{i|Seeds of Pumpkin}}. A Big Autumn counts as {{i|Any Large Pumpkin}}. A Big Autumn can be stored in a {{i|Stockbin}}.
